name: Xero Cloud Accounting
description: E-commerce friendly cloud bookkeeping with seamless A2X integration for accurate Amazon settlement splits.
fullDescription: Xero is an intuitive, collaborative cloud accounting system highly acclaimed by modern e-commerce accountants. With unlimited users per organization and deep support for international marketplace settlements through A2X, Xero simplifies complex accrual bookkeeping across global currencies.
features: Unlimited users on standard plans without per-seat licensing penalties
Native multi-currency conversion supporting over 160 global currencies
Flawless integration with A2X for Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and eBay reconciliation
Automated daily bank reconciliation with machine learning suggestion rules
Built-in invoice generation, bill payment workflows, and receipt scanning
